description: This file defines the NodeAccessGrantsCacheContext class, which manages cache contexts related to node access grants in Drupal, including cache tags, context IDs, and grant checks for different operations.

classes.name: NodeAccessGrantsCacheContext
classes.description: A cache context class for managing node access grants in Drupal, providing cache variation based on user permissions and node grants.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the cache context with a user and optionally an entity type manager, triggering a deprecation warning if the latter is not provided.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label for this cache context, 'Content access view grants'.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Determines the cache context string based on user permissions and node grants for a specific operation or all operations if none specified.

methods.name: checkNodeGrants
methods.description: Checks node grants for a specific operation, returning a string that represents the grants, optimized for 'view' operation if the user has global grants.

methods.name: getCacheableMetadata
methods.description: Returns cacheable metadata, including cache tags and max age, based on whether node grants are used and user data.
